name: iam:CreateAccessKey + iam:DeleteAccessKey
description: Delete an existing access key and create a new one for a target user, bypassing the 2-key AWS limit to gain access to the target user's permissions
author: Seth Art

required.description: Target IAM user must be in the Resource section
Target IAM user must be in the Resource section

additional.description: List existing access keys to identify which one to delete

admin: Target user has 2 access keys (maximum allowed)
Target user must have administrative permissions (e.g., AdministratorAccess)
lateral: Target user has 2 access keys (maximum allowed)

references.title: AWS IAM User Access Key Limits

techniques: T1098.001 - Account Manipulation: Additional Cloud Credentials

options.name: TARGET_USER
options.description: Target IAM username to create access keys for

options.name: DELETE_KEY_ID
options.description: Specific access key ID to delete (auto-detected if not set)

options.name: AUTO_SWITCH
options.description: Automatically switch to new identity after successful key creation
